name: portrait-depth-of-field
prompt: Using the 67js MCP tools and the build-67js-scene skill: make a tiny product scene (a box on a flat slab). Frame it like an 85 mm portrait lens with a shallow depth of field, subject sharp. Look at the result, then finish by calling scene_export_recipe. Keep it short.
expected: The exported recipe has camera.focalLength and exactly one depth of field control: camera.fStop, or effects.depthOfField.blur above 0 with a focusDistance. The agent looked at the scene after its last edit.

checks.label: a depth of field control is on
